## Resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Components and coordination

List changed UI, Apex, metadata and dependencies. Identify other teammates editing the same components and how their changes are incorporated.

## Validation

Record local checks, relevant Apex test results and browser smoke-test results. State any checks not completed.

## Shared org deployment

Record the latest org retrieval time and scope, the agreed deployment owner, the source commit and exact deployment scope. After deployment, add the job ID and result. Confirm that current org changes were compared before deployment.
